method: Single first-navigation pair in the same sandbox/in-app browser; unthrottled loopback, same empty synthetic account and 2000ms identity delay; different fresh origins. No production requests or mutation. This is not Lighthouse mobile, field p75, INP or statistical evidence.
limits: Useful content marker denotes the synthetic empty-account portfolio view, not all APIs complete.
Final mobile performance target remains unverified.
Long-task entries are raw observations, not standardized TBT.
Final LCP means last observed candidate before leaving the page, not a field percentile.
